svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: SaaS onboarding journey subtitle: A new customer's path from first search to the first renewal, with what hurts and what to fix kind: journey stages: [Discover, Sign up, Set up, First value, Renew] layout: { spacing: compact } legend: solid: The customer's path dotted: Where it happens, what fixes it # Each lane is a row; every step names its stage (the column) and the customer's steps carry a # score from -2 to 2, which the emotion curve averages per stage. Only the touchpoints carry an # icon, the channel each one is; text cards keep the five columns narrow enough to read on a page. groups: actions: { type: lane, label: Customer actions } touchpoints: { type: lane, label: Touchpoints } pains: { type: lane, label: Pain points, color: "#cf222e" } ideas: { type: lane, label: Opportunities, color: "#1a7f37" } nodes: search: { in: actions, stage: Discover, label: Compares tools, note: Reads reviews and a comparison post, score: 1 } trial: { in: actions, stage: Sign up, label: Starts a free trial, note: Work email and password, score: -1 } import: { in: actions, stage: Set up, label: Imports their data, note: Uploads a CSV export, score: -2 } report: { in: actions, stage: First value, label: Shares a first report, note: The moment it clicks, score: 2 } invite: { in: actions, stage: First value, label: Invites the team, note: Three more seats, score: 1 } upgrade: { in: actions, stage: Renew, label: Upgrades to a paid plan, note: Before the trial ends, score: 1 } review: { in: touchpoints, stage: Discover, icon: generic:browser, label: Review site, note: G2 and blogs } form: { in: touchpoints, stage: Sign up, icon: generic:email, label: Sign-up form, note: Verify by email } wizard: { in: touchpoints, stage: Set up, icon: generic:etl, label: Import wizard, note: Column mapping } dash: { in: touchpoints, stage: First value, icon: generic:analytics, label: Dashboard, note: Share and invite } billing: { in: touchpoints, stage: Renew, icon: generic:notification, label: Trial-end email, note: Links to billing } spam: { in: pains, stage: Sign up, label: Verification lands in spam, note: A third never confirms } mapping: { in: pains, stage: Set up, label: Columns do not map, note: Dates and currencies fail } pricing: { in: pains, stage: Renew, label: Plans are hard to compare, note: Seats or usage? } magic: { in: ideas, stage: Sign up, label: Magic-link sign-in, note: "No password, no wait" } sample: { in: ideas, stage: Set up, label: Start with sample data, note: Map columns later } preview: { in: ideas, stage: Renew, label: Plan preview in the app, note: Cost at current usage } edges: - search -> trial -> import -> report -> invite -> upgrade - search ... review - trial ... form - import ... wizard - invite ... dash - upgrade ... billing - spam ... magic - mapping ... sample - pricing ... preview

svg.title: SaaS onboarding journey
svg.desc: SaaS onboarding journey. Customer journey in 5 stages (Discover, Sign up, Set up, First value, Renew) and 4 rows (Customer actions, Touchpoints, Pain points, Opportunities), 17 steps. Emotion from -2 to 2 by stage: Discover +1, Sign up -1, Set up -2, First value +1.5, Renew +1. Connections: Compares tools to Starts a free trial; Starts a free trial to Imports their data; Imports their data to Shares a first report; Shares a first report to Invites the team; Invites the team to Upgrades to a paid plan; Compares tools to Review site; Starts a free trial to Sign-up form; Imports their data to Import wizard; Invites the team to Dashboard; Upgrades to a paid plan to Trial-end email; Verification lands in spam to Magic-link sign-in; Columns do not map to Start with sample data; Plans are hard to compare to Plan preview in the app.
